title: Cover orb
note: The orb behind the cover. `thinking-orbs`' own `connecting` animation, painted through the package's engine at cover scale rather than at its 64px preset.

states.label: Held frame
states.note: The frame held at t = 0.6. This is what a capture should show every time.

states.label: Reduced motion
states.note: What a reader with prefers-reduced-motion gets: the orb is there, it does not wire itself.

states.label: Light ground
states.note: Dark ink on paper — the ground a cover gets when the item overrides its theme.
